title: Learn Kerala Natanam from Guru Gopinath Natanagramam

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor sits on the floor playing a rhythmic instrument while leading a group of dancers through structured sequences. Instruction is delivered through vocal counts and spoken Malayalam descriptions of movements.

lesson_structure.note: Instructor leads dancers in opening posture
Instructor announces third threshold movement and leads practice
Instructor announces fourth movement and guides dancers
Instructor guides dancers through secondary rhythmic steps

steps_taught.name: Ranga Vandanam
steps_taught.description: Opening salutation and threshold movement sequence.

steps_taught.name: Third Threshold
steps_taught.description: Intermediate footwork and arm coordination pattern.

what_works: Clear vocal rhythm accompaniment provided by the teacher
what_hinders: Lack of verbal breakdown of foot placement details

evidence_segments.observation: Instructor seated on the floor playing rhythm instrument while group performs in unison.

extraction.distinctive_method: Sitting on the floor providing live vocal rhythm and percussive accompaniment while students perform standing choreography.
